evidence_scope: western Japan; source identifies A. glandulosa at species level rather than the Izu var. hancei population
claim_boundary: Effective pollinators were measured directly in A. glandulosa and the source concludes functional specialization on short-tongued scoliid wasps/solitary bees; transfer to var. hancei and Izu populations remains an external species-level inference.

evidence_scope: multiple Japanese mainland/coastal populations; not the Izu 2024 populations
claim_boundary: The source shows self-incompatibility, reduced open relative to outcross reproduction, and several bee taxa as primary pollinators. This resolves broad pollinator dependence but not an exclusive long-tongued or Bombus dependency.

evidence_scope: Japanese F. japonicum var. japonicum literature reports bees flies syrphids and butterflies as pollinators, but the recovered contemporary source does not itself quantify their effectiveness in the Izu target populations
claim_boundary: Broad pollinator use is supported as species context, but effectiveness-defined dependence in the exact Izu populations remains unresolved; keep the prospective control based on source-native network breadth, not this external description.

evidence_scope: direct reproductive-biology study from China; geographic transfer to Japanese/Izu populations unresolved
claim_boundary: The source directly reports entomophily and diverse visitors enhancing pollination efficiency, but it is not a Japanese or Izu population and therefore cannot define the target population's effective dependency class.

evidence_scope: Japan species-level pollination-efficiency experiment; not the exact Izu 2024 populations
claim_boundary: Diurnal Tetralonia/Lasioglossum bees and nocturnal Theretra hawkmoths all transfer pollen; the source measures efficiency and shows a mixed effective guild rather than Bombus dependence.

evidence_scope: 2017 mainland/island network and fruit-set response; effective dependency breadth unresolved
claim_boundary: The source resolves a reproductive response to the long-tongued-pollinator gradient, but does not establish an exclusive effective-pollinator dependency class.

evidence_scope: 2017 source records functional pollinator interactions; independent effectiveness/dependency experiment not recovered
claim_boundary: Interaction identity alone is insufficient to assign an effectiveness-defined dependency class.

evidence_scope: Japanese O. corniculata populations; exact mapping of the Izu var. trichocaulon target to floral morph/breeding state unresolved
claim_boundary: Japanese populations range from autogamous homostyled to predominantly outcrossing/low-autonomous-selfing morphs. The Izu target cannot receive a single dependency class until its population-level floral morph/breeding state is matched.

evidence_scope: search included accepted name and Polygonum senticosum synonym; no direct effectiveness-defined pollination study recovered
claim_boundary: Keep unresolved rather than infer pollination dependence from floral form, family or network visitation alone.

evidence_scope: Sanin coastal Japan; species-level pollination study, not the exact Izu 2024 populations
primary_source: Maeta et al. 2004, Bulletin of the Hoshizaki Green Foundation 7:275-303; Shimane repository 55148
claim_boundary: The source documents multiple promising hymenopteran pollinators and a particularly well-matched dominant Megachile kobensis interaction. This excludes strict Bombus dependence but does not make the exact Izu population effectiveness composition identical.
